name: pam_faildelay
description: Delay on login failure to prevent brute-force attacks
detailed_description: Introduces a delay (sleep) after a failed login attempt. The delay increases security by reducing the rate at which an attacker can attempt password guesses. Configurable delay duration and can be skipped under certain conditions.

parameters.delay: Delay in microseconds after failed authentication attempt (default: 1000000)
parameters.nights: Skip delay during night hours (alternative to delay)
parameters.user: Specific user to apply delay for

notes:
Provides rate-limiting protection against brute-force attacks by introducing configurable delays after failed authentication attempts. Often used in conjunction with pam_faillock or pam_tally2 for comprehensive account protection.
